title: deepslate to polished deepslate
description: Add a recipe: craft polished deepslate from deepslate (it was only possible to create it from cobbles deepslate)
body:
Add a recipe that allows the player to craft polished deepslate from deepslate (it was only possible to create it from cobbles deepslate).

the recipe is as follow:
